packs.title: Pronunciation checks
packs.intro: Download a language to check how clearly each word you read aloud comes across. Language packs are shared by everyone who uses this device.
packs.honesty: Checks run on this device with open-source Whisper models, so recordings never leave it. They estimate how clearly each word came across, not your accent.
packs.enhancedHint: More accurate English checks, larger download
packs.sharedMissing: These languages share one model. Downloading the first takes {size}; adding more after that is instant.
packs.sharedPresent: The shared model ({size}) is on this device. Adding a language is instant, and removing one keeps the model while another language still uses it.
